_ww-text_text.en: Standardize wholesale underwriting before an offer is sent.
Enter conservative ARV from relevant sold comps
Calculate MAO = ARV × 0.70 − Rehab − Desired Fee
Save analysis to the property / acquisition record
• The formula is a starting point, not a substitute for comp review
• Keep comp set and rehab assumptions attached to the deal
• Show spread between ask and MAO
• Podio writeback should store final approved offer amount
